methodology.model: closed loop, one in-flight operation per worker; message stages end on time or request limit
methodology.latency: client monotonic elapsed, no automatic retry in measurement
methodology.note: Bounded local load; short capped stages are bursts, not sustainable capacity. Driver shares the host.

lowLoad.pacing: wait for delivery, then 200ms before next send
